mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_replenishment_suggestion ( suggestion_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, warehouse_id, current_stock, avg_daily_sales, lead_time_days, safety_stock, suggested_quantity, priority, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{suggestionId}, #{tenantId}, #{sellerSku}, #{warehouseId}, #{currentStock}, #{avgDailySales}, #{leadTimeDays}, #{safetyStock}, #{suggestedQuantity}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_replenishment_suggestion SET seller_sku = #{sellerSku}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, current_stock = #{currentStock}, avg_daily_sales = #{avgDailySales}, lead_time_days = #{leadTimeDays}, safety_stock = #{safetyStock}, suggested_quantity = #{suggestedQuantity}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND suggestion_id = #{suggestionId}
mapper.select: SELECT suggestion_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, warehouse_id, current_stock, avg_daily_sales, lead_time_days, safety_stock, suggested_quantity, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_replenishment_suggestion WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND suggestion_id = #{suggestionId}

SELECT suggestion_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, warehouse_id, current_stock, avg_daily_sales, lead_time_days, safety_stock, suggested_quantity, priority, status, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_replenishment_suggestion WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
